text: members, contributors, leaders pledge make participation community harassment-free experience everyone, regardless age, body size, visible invisible disability, ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender identity expression, level experience, education, socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance, race, caste, color, religion, sexual identity orientation. pledge act interact ways contribute open, welcoming, diverse, inclusive, healthy community.

title: Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct
text: Examples behavior contributes positive environment community include: Demonstrating empathy kindness toward people respectful differing opinions, viewpoints, experiences Giving gracefully accepting constructive feedback Accepting responsibility apologizing affected mistakes, learning experience Focusing best just us individuals, overall community Examples unacceptable behavior include: use sexualized language imagery, sexual attention advances kind Trolling, insulting derogatory comments, personal political attacks Public private harassment Publishing others’ private information, physical email address, without explicit permission conduct reasonably considered inappropriate professional setting

text: Community leaders responsible clarifying enforcing standards acceptable behavior take appropriate fair corrective action response behavior deem inappropriate, threatening, offensive, harmful. title: Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct

title: STAC Query URL Generator — stacit
text: extent numeric vector (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax) longlat, character MGRS 100km grid code date character, Date, POSIXt specifying temporal query. Length 1 implied interval length 2 explicit range. Default "" uses today's date. collections character; STAC collection identifier(s) search. Default "sentinel-2-c1-l2a" (Sentinel-2 Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs). provider character; base URL STAC API search endpoint. Default uses Element 84's Earth Search. Also supports Microsoft Planetary Computer. gdal_stacit logical; TRUE, return GDAL STACIT driver DSN string instead URL. Default FALSE. limit integer; maximum number items return per query. Default 300.

title: STAC Query URL Generator — stacit

title: STAC Query URL Generator — stacit
text: extent can specified either: numeric vector length 4 giving xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax longitude/latitude (EPSG:4326) character string giving 100km MGRS grid square code (e.g. "43DFD") Extents cross anti-meridian (.e. xmin < -180 xmax > 180) automatically split two queries, one side ±180° boundary. handles case projected extent (e.g. UTM) spans anti-meridian STAC APIs truncate bounding boxes -180/180.

title: STAC Query URL Generator — stacit
text: date parameter accepts flexible input formats expanded ISO 8601 datetime intervals: Year : "2024" becomes 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z/2024-12-31T23:59:59Z Year-month: "2024-06" expands full month interval Full date: "2024-06-15" expands single day Date range: c("2024-01-01", "2024-01-31") explicit start/end Date POSIXt objects also accepted

code: # Simple bounding box query for today stacit(c(140, 145, -43, -40)) #> [1] "https://earth-search.aws.element84.com/v1/search?collections=sentinel-2-c1-l2a&bbox=140,-43,145,-40&datetime=2026-09-30T00:00:00Z/2026-09-30T23:59:59Z&limit=300"  # MGRS grid square for a specific month stacit("43DFD", date = "2025-01") #> [1] "https://earth-search.aws.element84.com/v1/search?collections=sentinel-2-c1-l2a&query=%7B%22grid:code%22:%7B%22eq%22:%22MGRS-43DFD%22%7D%7D&datetime=2025-01-01T00:00:00Z/2025-01-31T23:59:59Z&limit=300"  # Date range query stacit(c(140, 145, -43, -40), date = c("2024-06-01", "2024-06-30")) #> [1] "https://earth-search.aws.element84.com/v1/search?collections=sentinel-2-c1-l2a&bbox=140,-43,145,-40&datetime=2024-06-01T00:00:00Z/2024-06-30T23:59:59Z&limit=300"  # Anti-meridian crossing returns two queries stacit(c(179, 181, -16, -15), date = "2024-03") #> [1] "https://earth-search.aws.element84.com/v1/search?collections=sentinel-2-c1-l2a&bbox=179,-16,180,-15&datetime=2024-03-01T00:00:00Z/2024-03-31T23:59:59Z&limit=300"   #> [2] "https://earth-search.aws.element84.com/v1/search?collections=sentinel-2-c1-l2a&bbox=-180,-16,-179,-15&datetime=2024-03-01T00:00:00Z/2024-03-31T23:59:59Z&limit=300"  # Use Planetary Computer instead of Earth Search stacit(c(140, 145, -43, -40),        provider = "https://planetarycomputer.microsoft.com/api/stac/v1/search") #> [1] "https://planetarycomputer.microsoft.com/api/stac/v1/search?collections=sentinel-2-c1-l2a&bbox=140,-43,145,-40&datetime=2026-09-30T00:00:00Z/2026-09-30T23:59:59Z&limit=300"  # Query Landsat collection stacit(c(140, 145, -43, -40), collections = "landsat-c2-l2", date = "2024") #> [1] "https://earth-search.aws.element84.com/v1/search?collections=landsat-c2-l2&bbox=140,-43,145,-40&datetime=2024-01-01T00:00:00Z/2024-12-31T23:59:59Z&limit=300"

Undress dsn::unvsicurl() take bare url dsn_list(). New dsn_list() dsn_info() discovery – filter theme, provider, kind; inspect crs, license, liveness status. Existing source functions (gebco(), cop30(), etc.) retained thin shims dsn(), change behaviour. Depends dsn package chainable VSI prefix verbs (vsicurl(), vsizip(), …).
